question.text: The number of amplitude modulated broadcast stations that can be accommodated in a $300 \mathrm{kHz}$ band width for the highest modulating frequency $15 \mathrm{kHz}$ will be:

solution.text:
Given, modulating frequency $f_m$ $=15 \mathrm{KHz}$
$\therefore \quad$ Bandwidth of one channel $=2 f_m=30 \mathrm{kHz}$
$\therefore \quad$ No of channels accommodate
$$
=\frac{300 \mathrm{kHz}}{30 \mathrm{kHz}}=10
$$
